predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Como vs Manchester United: Expected Goals, Lineup Vulnerabilities & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Como's positional cohesion and home dominance hold the advantage over an injury-depleted Manchester United side, pointing toward a 2:1 home victory with a 1:1 stalemate retained as secondary coverage.
possibilityAssessment: Como 2:1 Manchester United: Como exploit an emergency Red Devils central defense to secure a historic Champions League home win (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Como 1:1 Manchester United: United absorb sustained pressure and utilize transition quality through Bruno Fernandes to escape with a point (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Total Goals Over 2.5: High chance-creation frequency and defensive miscommunications generate three or more combined goals (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Carrick navigates severe defensive crisis against Fàbregas's high-flying Como

spf.comment: Como's dominant home record and United's six-match winless slide support the hosts, with the draw hedge covering United's persistent 1-1 stalemate pattern.

over_under.comment: A 2.75 combined goal expectancy and United's makeshift back four favor an open encounter clearing the 2.5 goal threshold.

score.comment: A 2:1 home victory serves as the primary statistical anchor, supported by a secondary 1:1 draw branch.

goals.comment: Three goals represent the primary density peak, closely followed by a two-goal stalemate scenario.

bqc.comment: United are projected to remain competitive through a tight first half before Como's superior continuity tells in the second period.
